title: Paul McCartney live: Hard Rock Live, Hollywood | 2022
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Hollywood, Florida, USA, on 25 May 2022.

It was the ninth show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025. This concert was seen by just 7,000 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

Ringo Starr performed at the Hard Rock Live on 3 July 2008, 15 July 2010, 30 June 2012, 17 September 2022, and 20 June 2025.
